name: io.github.gregcastro23/alchm-kitchen
description: Thirteen culinary & food tools: transits, ingredients, recipes, synastry, grocery lists, substitutions, pantry recommendations, evidence snapshots and reflections.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_USER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional alchm.kitchen API key (mint at https://alchm.kitchen/profile/api-keys). Without DATABASE_URL the server forwards each call to the hosted endpoint, which validates the key and applies billing. Without a key, read tools run locally in demo mode; reflection publication requires a key.

environmentVariables.name: ALCHM_MCP_USER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Alias for MCP_USER_API_KEY, supported in sanitized Planetary Agents client environments.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Operator-only PostgreSQL connection string. Setting it runs the tools in-process and validates keys and ESMS billing locally; leave it unset to use the hosted service (with a key) or demo mode (without).

environmentVariables.name: ALCHM_MCP_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. auto (the default): with an API key and no DATABASE_URL the server forwards to the hosted endpoint, otherwise it runs in-process. remote: always forward to the hosted endpoint, even if an unrelated DATABASE_URL is set in the environment (needs MCP_USER_API_KEY). local: always run in-process (with a key and no DATABASE_URL, tool calls still go to the hosted REST endpoint under ALCHM_MCP_BACKEND_URL).

environmentVariables.name: ALCHM_MCP_REMOTE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. The hosted MCP endpoint a key-only install forwards to, and the place your API key is sent: set it only to a host you trust. Defaults to https://alchm.kitchen/api/mcp; must be https (http is accepted only for localhost).

environmentVariables.name: ALCHM_MCP_BACKEND_URL
environmentVariables.description: Backend origin serving /api/astrologize. Bundled artifacts default to https://alchm.kitchen; source runs default to http://localhost:3000. It is also where the in-process server sends a keyed tool call when it has no database (ALCHM_MCP_MODE=local), so it is where your API key goes then: https, or http only for localhost, 127.0.0.1 and [::1], without credentials, a query string or a fragment.
